posts.community: Bajaj Auto - Is the company back on growth track?
posts.text: Rajiv Bajaj had to be dragged kicking and screaming to make EVs. He was one of the vociferours opponents to the EV push from the Govt. I agee they could have played a much bigger role in India and globally in bringing EV in. The seem to have a good presence in Latam, Africa, South and South East asia, however I don’t see them do anything too agressive to expand.

posts.text: Bajaj Auto: Did the Torchbearer of Indian Industry Miss Its Opportunity to Lead India’s EV Revolution? I have been thinking about Bajaj Auto’s positioning in India’s electric two-wheeler transition. One question keeps coming to mind: Given Bajaj’s financial strength, manufacturing capabilities, brand equity and distribution network, could it have played a much bigger role in transforming India’s EV 2W industry? This is not just about market share or profitability. It is also about the legacy and expectations associated with the Bajaj name. 1. The legacy of Bajaj – More than just an automobile…
